newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH AUG CONSTRUCTION COSTS FALL 0.9 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH AUG CONSTRUCTION COSTS FALL 0.9 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish construction costs fell 0.9 percent year-on-year in August after a 1.0 percent fall in July, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
The construction costs index rose 0.2 percent month-on-month in August, it said.
Year-on-year, material input costs fell 0.5 percent and other input costs fell 4.2 percent while labour costs rose 0.8 percent.
Month-on-month, material input costs rose 0.3 percent and labour costs rose 0.3 percent but other input costs fell 0.1 percent, SF said.
